title: Little Fish: Checking the Mark Hoppus
content:
Andy explains why he is a hashtag legend, while he, Anna and Dan discuss YOUR facts . This week's subjects include pedestriennes, presidents and pyramid schemes. And the gang announce eight more Friend of the Podcast custodians.

Visit nosuchthingasafish.com for news about live shows, merchandise and more episodes.

Team includes Tara Dorrell, Joe Mayo and Ethan Ruparelia
